label: Split 10
description: Given 10 and a part a, state the complementary part (10 - a). E.g. split_10(7) -> 3. Leaf skill: directly assessable, no further decomposition. Distinct from the equivalent subtraction fact (10 - a = ?), which belongs to the Separate schema, not Part-Part-Whole -- transfer between them is not assumed.
source: Carpenter, Fennema, Franke, Levi & Empson, Children's Mathematics: Cognitively Guided Instruction (2nd ed., 2014)
